today.emptyBody: This board lists employees who have a work schedule. Set their schedules first.
today.emptyBodyReadOnly: This board fills in once an admin sets staff work schedules.

manualForm.title: Manual entry
manualForm.hoursHint: Leave a time empty if there is none yet.
manualForm.overnightHint: A departure earlier than the arrival is recorded on the next day.

schedule.title: Work schedules
schedule.subtitle: Each employee's working days, start and end times, and late tolerance.
schedule.pickBody: Select an employee to see and set their work schedule.
schedule.endHint: Set an end earlier than the start for a shift that runs past midnight.
schedule.effectiveHint: Changes apply from today. Earlier days keep the schedule that was in effect on them.
schedule.notSet: No work schedule yet. Turn on the working days, then save.

history.title: Attendance history
history.empty: No records in this date range
history.invalidRange: The start date must be on or before the end date

recap.title: Monthly recap
recap.pickBody: The selected employee's attendance appears here, by month or for any date range.

correction.title: Correct attendance
correction.bodyFor: {name}'s attendance for this day is corrected and recorded with the reason.
correction.body: The reason is kept with this correction.
correction.overnightHint: Earlier than the arrival, so it is recorded on the next day.
correction.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for the correction.

import.title: Import from an attendance device
import.body: Upload the device's export file. Its contents are shown first and not saved straight away.
import.columns: Recognised columns: staff number or employee name, date, time in, time out, notes.
import.emptyBody: Choose an attendance device export to see its contents.
import.problemsTitle: {count, plural, one {# row could not be read} other {# rows could not be read}}
import.mappingBody: These codes do not match any employee name. Choose the person once and it applies to all of their rows.
import.previewTitle: {count, plural, one {# row ready to save} other {# rows ready to save}}
import.applied: {count, plural, one {# row saved.} other {# rows saved.}}

self.title: Work attendance
self.doneBody: Arrival and departure are both recorded. Contact the admin if anything needs correcting.
self.hint: Tap once when you arrive and once more when you leave. The time comes from the school server.
self.holidayHint: Today is a holiday. You can still record attendance if needed.
self.unscheduledHint: Your work schedule has not been set up yet. Contact the admin to set it.
self.unscheduledHintManage: Your work schedule has not been set up yet.
self.confirmDepartureBody: Your arrival was recorded at {time}. Once your departure is recorded, only an admin can correct it.
